name: io.github.jefflitt1/health4ai
title: health4.ai
description: Query your own Apple Health data from Claude, Cursor, ChatGPT, or any MCP client. Local stdio server that reads from a Supabase/Postgres database you own; health4.ai never receives or stores your health data.

tools.name: get_health_summary
tools.description: Overview of key health metrics for the past N days: average steps, sleep, HRV, resting heart rate, and workout count.

tools.name: get_sleep
tools.description: Sleep analysis for the past N days, with per-night stage durations (REM, deep/core, light, awake).

tools.name: get_hrv_trend
tools.description: HRV (SDNN) trend over the past N days: daily averages, a 7-day rolling comparison, and trend direction.

tools.name: query_metric
tools.description: Time series for any HealthKit metric type: raw samples for windows up to 30 days, daily aggregates beyond that.

tools.name: get_workouts
tools.description: Recent workouts with type, duration, distance, and calories.

tools.name: get_daily_snapshot
tools.description: Everything recorded for one date (YYYY-MM-DD, default today): steps, sleep, workouts, HRV, resting heart rate, active energy, and other metrics.

tools.name: get_long_term_trend
tools.description: Long-term trend for any metric, merging recent daily data with historical daily summaries (default 24 months) for multi-year and seasonal analysis.

tools.name: get_coaching_brief
tools.description: Recent trends across key metrics summarized for a coaching conversation: recovery status, sleep quality, training load, and fitness trajectory.

tools.name: search_records
tools.description: Find days where a health metric crossed a threshold (daily totals for cumulative metrics, daily averages for rate metrics).

tools.name: get_metric_stats
tools.description: Personal baseline statistics for any health metric: min, max, mean, standard deviation, and p10 to p90 percentiles.

tools.name: compare_periods
tools.description: Compare a health metric between two date ranges (YYYY-MM-DD).

environmentVariables.name: DATABASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Postgres connection string for your Supabase project (transaction pooler; database password, not a service-role key).

environmentVariables.name: HEALTHKIT_USER_ID
environmentVariables.description: UUID of the Supabase Auth user whose HealthKit data to query.
